examples.arabic: هو حمل أكياسًا فيها طعام شهي.
examples.english: He carried bags containing delicious food.
examples.transliteration: Huwa hamala akyaasan feeha ta'amun shahiyy.
examples.storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

examples.arabic: شعرنا بخوف قليل لكن الطعام كان ممتازا
examples.english: We felt a little fear but the food was excellent.
examples.transliteration: Shaarna bikhawf qaleel lakin al-taam kana mumtaazan

examples.english: The student eats food for lunch.

examples.arabic: اختي تطبخ طعام الحفلة كل مساء
examples.english: My sister cooks the party food every evening
examples.transliteration: Ukhti tatbukh taam al hafla kulla masa

examples.arabic: تطبخ امي وليمة كبيرة من الطعام العربي اللذيذ
examples.english: My mother cooks a big feast of delicious Arabic food.
examples.transliteration: Tatbukhu ummee waleematon kabeeraton min attaaam alarabee alladheeth

examples.arabic: البارحة اجتمعنا حول طاولة الطعام لنتناول العشاء معا.
examples.english: Yesterday we gathered around the food table to eat dinner together.
examples.transliteration: Albariha ijtamana hawla tawilat altaam linatanawal alasha maan.
